name: resume-analyzer-chat
description: Analyze pasted or uploaded resume or CV with optional JD tailoring. Emits resume-audit-report. Not legal advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include resume paste, attachments, or job description.

inputs.name: resume-text
inputs.description: Pasted resume or CV plain text.

inputs.name: job-description
inputs.description: Optional job posting for keyword and tailoring section.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: resume-audit-report
outputs.description: Structured resume audit; empty when resume text is missing or unreadable.
